messages:
maya_releases: quick heads-up — release scheduled for tomorrow (v2.14.0). docs site deploy + SDK docs regen need to be done before 11:00 PT cutoff. who can own console/docs deploy?
kevin_eng: I can take SDK regen. which branch should I target? main or release/2.14?
maya_releases: SDK docs should be generated from release/2.14 (so links match the release). console/docs site should be built from main because the console UI changes already landed there.
liam_docs: I can run the site build + deploy at ~09:30 PT. liam will need the changelog snippet and the exact version bump commit.
anna_prod: changelog PR is #5123, contains the bullet points. version bump is on release/2.14 at commit abc1234 (short sha). also add a note about token quota label change in migration notes.
kevin_eng: thanks — I'll run the regen and open a docs PR against release/2.14. local command I'll use: ```make docs-regenerate SDK_VERSION=2.14.0 && git checkout -b regen/sdk-docs-2.14 && git push origin regen/sdk-docs-2.14``` then PR. will ping when CI passes.
liam_docs: perfect. once kevin's PR is merged to release/2.14 I will pull the release branch into the docs site build pipeline so public pages match.
kevin_eng: quick Q — do we need to regen Ruby SDK too or just python/js?
maya_releases: regen for all published SDKs please (python/js/ruby). small diff is fine.
ci-bot: SDK docs regen CI started for regen/sdk-docs-2.14 (job 7821) — running tests.
kevin_eng: regen done locally, pushed PR -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5234 (WIP). running unit tests now.
ci-bot: docs unit tests passed (7821) — artifacts uploaded.
liam_docs: noted. once PR merges, I'll update the docs site config to pull docs from release/2.14 for the SDK pages and from main for the console pages.
anna_prod: changelog approved in #5123, added migration note. please ensure the release notes include the console UI screenshots (they are in assets/screenshots/console-v2.14).
maya_releases: cutoff reminder: 11:00 PT tomorrow. after cutoff only critical fixes to release/2.14. please call out any rollbacks asap.
kevin_eng: PR merged to release/2.14 -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5234 (merged by kevin_eng). tagged SDK docs artifact.
ci-bot: docs-site build started (job 7890) — pulling release/2.14 + main mix.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window created for 2026-03-18 18:00:00 UTC.
liam_docs: docs-site build succeeded. deploy preview available at https://staging.docs.redwood.com/v/2.14-preview. I'm kicking the prod deploy now.
deploy-bot: prod deploy started (deploy id d-1147).
liam_docs: prod deploy complete. site live with SDK docs from release/2.14 and console pages from main. spot-checked screenshots and links.
kevin_eng: ran quick smoke for SDK clients — examples compile. :thumbsup:
maya_releases: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the release ticket with links to release notes, changelog, and docs. we hit cutoff and deploy constraints satisfied. :rocket:
